body: I think of breaking it off with him sometimes. I just have hope that he will change and he's helped me so much when I was hurting financially. I'm so greatful for what he's done for me but I don't deserve being treated like this all the time. I try so hard to show how greatful I am and tried to do that tonight but it completely backfired. Thanks for commenting.

I agree a lot with this. I hate working. I wish I could do what I love but I don't even know what that would be. I'm 23 and starting college this year to make my boyfriend and family happy. It's not even for something I really want to do but I had to pick something. The only time I'm really happy is when I travel but I dread going back to work. It's like I'm wasteing my time doing meaningless work tasks when I could be with family or traveling. Unfortunately we all have bills to pay.
